en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a long ox-drawn wagon train crossing an arid plain. At the front left is a covered wagon with large wooden wheels and a driver; a span of many oxen stretches across almost the entire width of the image. The landscape is flat and barren with low hills on the horizon. The bottom portion of the card is blank for writing, with red printed captions: the word 'Mossamedes' on the left, 'Carro de Boers' on the right, and a small publisher credit along the lower edge.
